biodegradable: Biodegradable waste is material microorganisms can break down, such as many food scraps and leaves.
plastic: Check local recycling acceptance and plastic resin code. Keep accepted packaging clean and dry.
segregation: Separate wet/organic, dry/recyclable and domestic hazardous waste according to local collection rules.
compost: Composting turns suitable organic scraps and garden waste into soil amendment under controlled aerobic conditions.
e-waste: Give electronics and batteries to authorized e-waste collection or take-back services; do not mix with household waste.
recycling: Recycling recovers usable materials but reducing and reusing usually avoid waste earlier.
india: Indian municipalities implement local solid-waste segregation and collection practices; check your city's official rules.
pollution: Prevent littering, avoid open burning of waste, and use authorized disposal services.
ai: AI can estimate waste quantities and assist sorting, but predictions need reliable data and validation.
